offering_description.value: Sells cloud-based human capital management software covering payroll, HR, time and attendance, and talent management to US employers. Sold directly by its own sales force and delivered as a single-database software-as-a-service platform.

primary_products.value: cloud HCM software; payroll software; time and attendance software; talent management software

primary_services.value: payroll processing; tax filing; benefits administration; implementation and support

customer_segment.value: B2B: US employers of many sizes, mainly small and mid-sized businesses

end_markets.value: human resources; payroll; healthcare; manufacturing; hospitality; professional services

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring per-employee monthly fees for the HCM software platform; service fees: payroll processing, tax filing and related services

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: sells its HCM platform, taking in employee and payroll data from employers and selling to businesses; service provider: runs payroll and tax filing on behalf of employers

geography_served.value: US national: employers across all 50 US states

specialization.value: related lines: HCM software, payroll, time and attendance, and talent management sharing the same employer customers and platform

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales force selling to employers across the US

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payroll tax filing, wage and employment laws, and data privacy rules apply to its payroll and HR services
